candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` so the state variable is never updated.
Replace `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` with `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1;` so the stored value is incremented.
Replace the timestamp update with `pastBlockTime = block.number;` so a different value is stored.
Delete `require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime);` so a second call in the same timestamp no longer reverts and can update `pastBlockTime` when P would have kept it unchanged.
Change the guard to `require(block.timestamp >= pastBlockTime);` so calls at equal timestamps succeed and update `pastBlockTime` where P reverts.
Move `pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;` above `require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime);` so the update persists even when the call subsequently reverts.
Delete the require(msg.value == 10 ether) check so calls with any value are accepted.
Delete the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) guard so multiple calls in the same block are allowed.
Replace the assignment pastBlockTime = block.timestamp with pastBlockTime = 0.
Invert the lottery condition to block.number % 15 != 0.
Delete the if-statement so no payout is ever transferred.
Move the pastBlockTime assignment after the payout if-statement so a same-block retry sees an unchanged pastBlockTime when a payout happens.
Change the payout condition to base on block.timestamp instead of block.number.
